prompt: A printed 'Sun & Moon' almanac panel bolted to a mountain TRAILHEAD information station near Tromso, Norway, for the date 2026-09-15, photographed at the signpost. In a crisp flat layout: a SUNRISE time and a SUNSET time (both HH:MM, with small sun-up / sun-down icons) and a MOON PANEL with the moon-phase NAME (e.g. 'Waxing Gibbous'), a matching moon-phase ICON, and the % illuminated. Put the place name Tromso and the date 2026-09-15 at the top. Use the REAL astronomical sunrise, sunset and moon phase for Tromso on exactly that date; make the day length equal sunset minus sunrise, and draw the moon icon to match the named phase and the illumination percentage. Every number and label sharp and legible.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show mountain trailhead information-station almanac panel for Tromso, weathered signpost setting? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: moon phase written out in words, in the part of this sign that is about the moon

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed sign. A moon phase is written out in words in it. Which of these words is printed here? Answer with exactly one of: new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full moon, waning gibbous, last quarter, waning crescent.

steps.target: percentage printed in the part of this sign that is about the moon -- ONE box holding just that printed figure together with its per-cent sign, from its first digit to the % sign and nothing else; not the moon-phase words, not the moon icon, not the sunrise or sunset times, and not the place name or the date.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed sign. A percentage is printed in it. If more than one percentage is printed here, read the one nearest the middle of this cut-out. Write down just that number, digits only, and leave out the per-cent sign.

steps.target: clock time printed under the sunrise heading of this sign (the heading next to the picture of a sun coming up) -- ONE box holding just that HH:MM figure, from its first digit to its last and nothing else; not the sunrise heading word itself, not the sun-up icon, not the sunset time, and not the moon panel's phase words or percentage.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed sign. A clock time is printed in it. Copy that time exactly as it is printed, in HH:MM form, and add am or pm only if those letters are printed too. Write nothing else.

steps.target: the SUNSET block of this sign

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up of the sunset part of a printed sign. Copy the clock time printed there exactly as it appears, character for character, and add am or pm only if those letters are printed too. Write nothing else.
